# Choosing a model

Where these methods are:

- `session.models` — `Session.models`, a `SessionModels`

Every method here is generated from igni-core's RPC contract; its documentation is igni's own. The examples run inside an `async` function with `igni` an open `IgniClient` and `session` one of its sessions ([Quick start](/docs/sdk/igni-client/quick-start)).

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.models.list()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models#session-models-list) | List the models this session can run on. |
| [`session.models.switch()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models#session-models-switch) | Make another model the one this session's agent runs on. |

## session.models.list()

List the models this session can run on.

```python
async def list(self) -> ModelRegistryResult
```

Takes no arguments. Returns the `default` model's name, the
largest context window configured, and `registry`: every model by
name, with its provider and settings.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** [`ModelRegistryResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#modelregistryresult).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_model_registry`, scope `session`, area `models`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
listed = await session.models.list()
print(listed.default, listed.max_context_window)
```

## session.models.switch()

Make another model the one this session's agent runs on.

```python
async def switch(self, model_name: str) -> InfoMessage
```

`model_name` is a name from the model registry
(`get_model_registry`). The choice is also saved as the default
for new sessions. Returns an `info` message, sent in place of an
`rpc_response`, saying the model switched, with a note for any
part of the choice that could not be saved. Fails when the model is
not in the registry.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_name` | `str` | required | `model_name` is a name from the model registry (`get_model_registry`). |

**Returns** [`InfoMessage`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/events-reference#infomessage).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `switch_model`, scope `session`, area `models`; igni answers with `message`.

**Example**

```python
info = await session.models.switch("igni-large")
print(info.text)
```
